methods.name: Critical BRC word, primitive-orbit and Euler-prefix arithmetic
capabilities: exact total and based-closed critical dominant branch-word counts from integer K
exact primitive periodic-orbit counts by Mobius inversion
exact truncated primitive-orbit Euler-product coefficients with determinant cross-check
verified finite prefix bundling of total/closed/primitive/zeta data
methods.core_law: For the canonical integer critical-degeneracy matrix K, T_n=tr(K^n)=sum_{d|n}dP_d and 1/det(I-zK)=product_n(1-z^n)^(-P_n); all data are exact rational-gauge invariants because K itself is gauge invariant.
methods.hard_boundary: Primitive periodic edge-word orbits are not WBRC-T29 simple feedback-support circuits and P_n are not arithmetic prime counts. Classical dynamical-zeta/entropy structure only; no runtime orbit-enumeration speedup, Shannon-probability or infinite-state claim.
